evals.name: cf-service-instance-depends-on-all-same-space-roles
evals.description: Generation maps role-task dependencies to explicit Terraform dependencies.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create space dev-apps
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space`, `name = dev-apps`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Assign developer in dev-apps
  - Depends on: T-001
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space_role`, `space_name = dev-apps`, `username = alice@example.com`, `role_type = space_developer`, `origin = sap.ids`
- [ ] T-003 `[dev]` Assign manager in dev-apps
  - Depends on: T-001
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space_role`, `space_name = dev-apps`, `username = bob@example.com`, `role_type = space_manager`, `origin = sap.ids`
- [ ] T-004 `[dev]` Create orders service
  - Depends on: T-001, T-002, T-003
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_service_instance`, `cf_space = dev-apps`, `service_offering_name = xsuaa`, `service_plan_name = application`

evals.prompt: Generate Terraform for dev. Use SSO/token authentication if prompted.

assertions.text: The generated cloudfoundry_service_instance retains a reference to the dev-apps cloudfoundry_space resource
The service resource has an explicit depends_on containing both dev-apps cloudfoundry_space_role resources

evals.name: cf-role-dependencies-never-cross-space-or-provider-boundaries
evals.description: Only dependencies declared for the target CF space are emitted.

files.content:
# Task List

- [ ] T-001 `[dev]` Create space apps
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space`, `name = apps`
- [ ] T-002 `[dev]` Assign apps developer
  - Depends on: T-001
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space_role`, `space_name = apps`, `username = alice@example.com`, `role_type = space_developer`, `origin = sap.ids`
- [ ] T-003 `[dev]` Create space data
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space`, `name = data`
- [ ] T-004 `[dev]` Assign data developer
  - Depends on: T-003
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_space_role`, `space_name = data`, `username = bob@example.com`, `role_type = space_developer`, `origin = sap.ids`
- [ ] T-005 `[dev]` Create data service
  - Depends on: T-003, T-004
  - Path: terraform/dev/cf/main.tf
  - Task metadata: `resource_type = cloudfoundry_service_instance`, `cf_space = data`, `service_offering_name = xsuaa`, `service_plan_name = application`

evals.prompt: Generate Terraform for dev. Use SSO/token authentication if prompted.

assertions.text: The data service depends on the data role resource and not on the apps role resource
No CF space-role depends_on is added to the cloudfoundry_space or cloudfoundry_space_role resources themselves
